title: Debug test spawn list
description: The file game/tuning/debug_spawns.json, edited by hand. Debug mode only: normal mode never reads it. Not a wave (15-tech-constraints.md, rule 7; 91-decision-log.md, row 38). Each row places one drifter. The rows in play (all of them, or only those of the drifter type named by mode) are spread evenly over one loop of loop_ticks, in file order, and the loop repeats. A row needs only its drifter type and its position; everything else is the drifter's default. Loaded and checked by game/app/debug_spawns.py at startup in debug mode (docs/contracts/systems/app.md, Rules, Debug test spawn list). Rules this schema can't express, also enforced by the loader: type and mode name a built drifter type (DrifterType values); the row has the coordinate its drifter needs (the meteorite and the chain lightning need x, the satellite y); variant names one of that drifter's variants; invert is allowed only for a drifter that has one (the satellite and the chain lightning). The loader checks those by spawning every row once at load. Defaults: mode all, loop_ticks 180 (scope report DRA-39, Values needed: temporary stand-ins, not in the GDD). Owner of the schema: architect.

mode.description: Which rows play: "all" (the default when left out), or one drifter type value such as "satellite" or "chain_lightning" to play only that type's rows.

loop_ticks.description: Length of one loop, ticks. Default 180 when left out (3 s, kept from DRA-29). The rows in play are placed at offsets floor(i x loop_ticks / n) within it, for row i of n, counting from 0.

rows.description: The rows, in play order. May be empty.

type.description: The drifter type value, e.g. "meteorite", "satellite" or "chain_lightning".

x.description: Center x, screen px. Required for the meteorite and the chain lightning (the center of the box around its nodes). Left out for a satellite: just outside the wall it enters from.

y.description: Center y, screen px, y down. Required for the satellite. Left out for a meteorite or a chain lightning: just above the top edge.

variant.description: A variant name from the drifter's tuning file. Left out: the drifter's default variant.

invert.description: The spec's invert (the satellite enters from the right wall and flies left; the chain lightning's layout is mirrored, the triangle turned point down). Left out: false. A drifter without one refuses true.

speed.description: Level 1 speed, px/tick, along the drifter's path. Replaces the drifter's default speed; the level's hazard speed x still applies on top (scope report DRA-39, Values needed: Director, temporary stand-in). Left out: the drifter's default.
